verdict.rationale: Docs describe a built-in dashboard with detailed request logs/metrics and headers to control what's logged (docs-25, docs-34, docs-35), and marketing copy claims you can 'create comprehensive monitoring and alerting systems using AI Gateway's rich logging and metrics data' (docs-28), but no concrete export mechanism (e.g., Logpush, webhook, API for pulling logs into an external observability stack) is documented in this evidence pack.
